capabilities: Keeps card layouts, headings, lists, links and images visible when zoomed out
Draws and erases freehand strokes on cards and on the canvas between cards
Anchors underlines and circles to text so they follow edits and line wraps
Zooms the view to a readable text size around its center
Embeds Excalidraw drawings into a card or as a separate drawing card
disambiguation: Not a flowchart or diagram builder; it changes how canvas cards render at low zoom and adds freehand marks on top of them.
extras: Installation is described only as building from source; requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later on desktop. Excalidraw button labels follow the Obsidian interface language (Chinese or English).
intentEvidence: Read, edit, and draw on the same Obsidian canvas.
problem: Zooming out on a canvas shrinks card text into unreadable blocks, so you cannot see how notes fit together while still reading them.

relations.evidence: enable the Excalidraw community plugin and click the shapes button on the Canvas toolbar

summary: Keeps canvas cards' original layouts readable when zoomed out and adds freehand drawing whose marks follow text edits.
